questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.chapter: General Principles and Processes of Isolation of Metals
questions.q: Which of the following is used to prepare the inner lining of a blast furnance?
questions.solution:
The inner lining of a blast furnace is subjected to extremely high temperatures and chemical reactions. It is constructed using refractory materials that can withstand these conditions. Fire clay bricks, which are composed primarily of silica and alumina, are commonly used for the lining of the blast furnace because they possess high thermal resistance and structural stability at the operating temperatures of the furnace.

Answer: Fire clay bricks

questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.chapter: General Principles and Processes of Isolation of Metals
questions.q: The reducing agent which is used to reduce iron oxide in blast furnace is
questions.solution:
In the blast furnace, iron oxides such as $\mathrm{Fe_2O_3}$ are reduced to metallic iron. The process involves two main reducing agents: coke ($\mathrm{C}$) and carbon monoxide ($\mathrm{CO}$).

Coke acts as the primary fuel and also reacts with oxygen to form $\mathrm{CO_2}$, which is then reduced by more coke to form $\mathrm{CO}$ according to the reaction $\mathrm{C} + \mathrm{CO_2} \rightarrow 2\mathrm{CO}$.

The carbon monoxide ($\mathrm{CO}$) is the actual chemical reducing agent that reduces the iron oxides in the upper, cooler parts of the furnace, for example: $\mathrm{Fe_2O_3} + 3\mathrm{CO} \rightarrow 2\mathrm{Fe} + 3\mathrm{CO_2}$.

While coke is the source of the reducing agent, $\mathrm{CO}$ is the primary reducing agent that performs the reduction of iron oxides in the blast furnace.

Answer: $\mathrm{CO}$

minimise the heat loss due to radiation.

questions.q: Sodium cyanide is added as a depressant in the froth floatation process when the ore contains a mixture of $\mathrm{ZnS}$ and PbS. This is because
options: $\mathrm{Pb}(\mathrm{CN})_{2}$ gets precipitated without any effect on $\mathrm{ZnS}$
ZnS forms soluble complex, while PbS forms froth.
PbS forms soluble complex, while $\mathrm{ZnS}$ forms froth.
$\mathrm{Zn}\left(\mathrm{CN}_{2}\right.$ gets precipitated without any effect on PbS
questions.solution: $\mathrm{NaCN}$ forms a soluble complex with $\mathrm{ZnS}$ thus, it selectively prevents $\mathrm{ZnS}$ from coming to the froth but allows $\mathrm{PbS}$ to come with the froth.

questions.q: Identify the reaction that doesn't take place during the smelting process of copper extraction
questions.solution:
The reaction that doesn't take place during the smelting process of extraction is

2 \mathrm{FeS}+3 \mathrm{O}_{2} \longrightarrow 2 \mathrm{FeO}+2 \mathrm{SO}_{2} \uparrow

This reaction occurs during roasting, which comes before smelting.
